notice: PLANTED FICTIONAL RECORDS for the fictional demo case. Every name, record and URL here is invented; *.example domains are reserved (RFC 2606) and resolve nowhere. Never present any of it as a real finding.

records.title: Morrowgate Financial Conduct Office order 0001 (fictional)

records.title: news.example: 'Glimmerquay depositors locked out' (fictional)

records.title: archive.example snapshot of glimmerquay-yield.example, January 2026 (fictional)
